data.title: The package ships the reference generator, not the generated reference
data.why: Measured both: dist/reference.json costs 6.2 KB packed and 39.7 KB unpacked, scripts/reference.mjs costs 1.9 KB and 4.9 KB. The data has no use the CLI does not already serve — an agent runs schema --json — so the only consumer is the site, and the site can run the generator. Eight times cheaper for every install, same result.
data.rejected: Ship dist/reference.json: +16% unpacked on every install, to save one consumer one command
